import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_ef15',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
test=[[0]*26 for _ in range(26)]
for r in range(26):
    c=r+9
    if c<26: test[r][c]=5
    c=r-2
    if 0<=c<26: test[r][c]=4
    for d in (-8,-9):
        c=r+d
        if 0<=c<26: test[r][c]=3
out=mod.transform(test)
print('dims',len(out),len(out[0]),'first rows',out[:4])
print('input lane count',len({c-r for r,row in enumerate(test) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v}))
import json
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':out}))
